title: ALMA Detection of Extended Millimeter Halos in the HD 32297 and HD 61005 Debris Disks
question: Do the HD 32297 and HD 61005 edge-on debris disks, known for swept-back wings in scattered light, show extended millimeter-grain halos, and what is their radial structure?

data.arrays: 36 antennas (Cycle 3); 27 and 31 antennas for Cycle 1 HD 61005
data.sensitivity: rms 14 and 13 μJy/beam (HD 32297, HD 61005); CO rms 1.0 mJy/beam

what.value: Scattered light images (HST STIS) shown with ALMA contours

evidence.quote: previous *Hubble Space Telescope* (HST) STIS coronagraphic images of optical scattered light from (cite: sch14)
$A_{21}=6.91\times10^{-7}$ s$^{-1}$ is the Einstein A coefficient (cite: hol05)
a commonly used value in the literature is $\kappa_\nu = 2.3$ cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ at 1.3 mm (cite: beck90)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration, statwt reweighting, 30 s averaging

recipe.goal: Fit two-component broken power-law belt+halo model to visibilities
recipe.method: Optically thin, flat, axisymmetric model, T∝r^-0.5, broken power-law Σ; synthetic visibilities compared with data
assumptions: Continuous surface density at R_halo; no vertical structure

recipe.goal: Derive CO line properties and gas mass
recipe.method: Moment maps, integrated flux over 3σ region, optically thin LTE mass at 30 K, optical depth estimate
assumptions: LTE, optically thin, T=30 K, CO/H2=1e-4

recipe.goal: Estimate halo and belt dust masses
recipe.method: Optically thin M=F D^2/(κ B(T)), dust temperature from radiative equilibrium with emission efficiency β=0.7
assumptions: κ=2.3 cm2/g for belt, 1.3 cm2/g for halo micron grains

evidence.quote: The halos extend to $440\pm32$ AU and $188\pm8$ AU, respectively.

answer_key.quantity: Belt surface density index x1 (HD 32297, HD 61005)
Halo surface density index x2 (HD 32297, HD 61005)

evidence.quote: This approach yields a total CO mass of $M_\text{CO} = 4.32\times10^{-4}~M_\oplus$.
yields a total mass of millimeter-sized grains of $0.57\pm0.07$ $M_\oplus$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method details for CO
CLEAN mask, cell size, image size, iteration threshold
Initial walker positions and burn-in length
Channel binning/velocity range for CO moment maps
Whether combined datasets were rescaled/phase-aligned between epochs
missing_for_reproduction: Model code and priors implementation details beyond description
score_reason: Data and software are public and fitting recipe is well described, but imaging details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, clear model, numeric results in Table 2.
